title: Element Families: Groups 1, 17 and 18
summary: The alkali metals, the halogens and the noble gases: same outer electrons, similar properties, and clear trends down each group.

ib.note: Group trends explained in more depth in MYP 4

cbse.chapter: Ch 3: Classification of Elements and Periodicity (periodic trends)

objectives: I can describe the properties of the alkali metals, halogens and noble gases.
I can describe the trends in reactivity down group 1 and group 17.
I can explain the properties of each group using outer electrons.
misconceptions: Reactivity always increases down every group (it decreases down group 17).
Noble gases can never react with anything (a few heavy ones can form compounds).
